pos.searchHelp: Search the real company catalog by name, SKU or code. Availability is calculated for the selected warehouse.
pos.warehouseHelp: Required. The warehouse determines stock availability and the site attached to the sale.
pos.quantityHelp: Quantity sold. It must be greater than zero and remain within available stock when negative stock is forbidden.
pos.priceHelp: Catalog price. Only a module manager may change it; a business reason is then required.
pos.discountHelp: Optional manual discount. A non-zero discount is a commercial override and requires a reason.
pos.overrideHelp: Required only when a price is changed, a discount is entered or an item has no configured reference price.
pos.paymentMethodHelp: Choose how the customer pays. The financial account must exist in this company and use the ticket currency.
pos.cashAccountHelp: Choose one of your open tills in the ticket currency. The server checks that the session is still open and belongs to you.
pos.accountHelp: Choose an active financial account in the ticket currency.
pos.amountHelp: The sum of all payment lines must match the ticket total exactly.
pos.splitHelp: Enable only when the customer pays with two distinct financial accounts.
pos.reviewDescription: Review the basket, warehouse, till or payment accounts and totals before creating the receipt.
pos.missingWarehouse: Select an active store or warehouse before reviewing the sale.
pos.emptyCart: Add at least one valid product or service to the basket.
pos.invalidCart: Check quantities, prices and discounts in the basket before continuing.
pos.overrideRequired: Enter a business reason of at least 3 characters for the price or discount override.
pos.overrideForbidden: This basket requires a price or discount override, but your role is not allowed to perform it.
pos.missingPayment: Choose a valid financial account for the first payment.
pos.missingSecondPayment: Choose a valid, distinct financial account for the second payment.
pos.paymentMismatch: Payment amounts must be positive and their total must equal the ticket total.
pos.noWrite: You can view the POS, but your role cannot record a sale.
pos.tillCurrency: The selected cash till must use the same currency as the ticket.
pos.serverAuthority: The server remains authoritative for price, tax, stock and accounting posting.
pos.mixedCurrency: A single POS receipt cannot mix currencies.
pos.itemUnavailable: This item is not available in the selected warehouse.
pos.noAccountAvailable: No compatible account is available for this payment method and currency.
pos.selectedTillMismatch: The preferred till does not match the ticket currency. Choose a compatible till or another payment method.
pos.reviewSafety: No financial posting or stock issue is created before your explicit confirmation.
pos.reasonHelp: Explain why this completed receipt must be reversed. The original receipt remains in the audit trail.
pos.reasonRequired: Enter a reversal reason of at least 3 characters.

posCash.title: My point-of-sale tills
posCash.description: Choose the open till used for cash payments. You can keep several tills and currencies open in parallel.
posCash.openAnotherHelp: Only active cash accounts from this company are proposed. The server will revalidate the account, currency and cashier.
posCash.accountHelp: Choose a real cash account configured in Finance for this company.
posCash.amountHelp: Enter the amount physically present when the till starts. Zero is allowed.
posCash.accountRequired: Choose an available cash account before opening the till.
posCash.amountInvalid: The opening float must be zero or a positive amount.
posCash.noOpen: No till is open for this cashier. Open one before collecting a cash payment.
posCash.noAvailable: All available cash accounts already have an active or pending session.
posCash.noCashAccount: No active cash account is configured for this company.

mobileMoney.providerHelp: Choose an active provider with a wallet configured in the currency of the selected till.
mobileMoney.walletHelp: The wallet is determined automatically from the provider and till currency; the agent never selects an arbitrary wallet.
mobileMoney.operationHelp: Choose deposit when the customer gives cash and withdrawal when the till gives cash to the customer.
mobileMoney.phoneHelp: Enter the customer phone number. The server normalizes it using the company country and validates the international format.
mobileMoney.amountHelp: Main amount given or withdrawn by the customer. It must be strictly positive.
mobileMoney.feeHelp: Fee charged to the customer for this operation. Enter zero when no fee is charged.
mobileMoney.commissionHelp: Expected provider commission for the operation. Enter zero when no commission applies.
mobileMoney.feeCollectionHelp: Specify how the customer fee is collected so the financial effect matches the real operation.
mobileMoney.referenceHelp: In manual mode, copy the reference provided by the operator after execution on its terminal. It is required and must be unique for that provider.
mobileMoney.connectedModeHelp: This provider is connected: the reference will come from the integration and must not be entered manually.
mobileMoney.tillHelp: The selected till currency automatically drives the operation currency and compatible provider wallet.
mobileMoney.providerRequired: Choose a Mobile Money provider available in the till currency.
mobileMoney.phoneRequired: Enter the customer phone number before reviewing the operation.
mobileMoney.amountInvalid: Enter a customer amount strictly greater than zero.
mobileMoney.feeInvalid: Customer fees must be zero or greater.
mobileMoney.commissionInvalid: Provider commission must be zero or greater.
mobileMoney.referenceRequired: Enter the provider reference: it is required for a manual operation.
mobileMoney.reviewDescription: Review the till, currency, wallet, customer number and amounts before starting the financial posting.
mobileMoney.reviewSafety: No till or wallet movement is created before your explicit confirmation.
mobileMoney.fieldErrorSummary: Correct the highlighted fields before continuing.
